{{Top|canon=Chief Medic}}
{{Otheruses|Chief Medic|more=medical officer}}
'''Chief medical officer''' was a rank given to the senior member of the medical staff assigned to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or planetary installation. The chief medical officer was usually a member of the command staff, and had absolute authority over medical matters.

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jos Vondar]] was chief medical officer at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]].

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]] was the chief medical officer of the [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Tuuve]] was the chief medical officer of the [[Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser]] ''[[Lycoming]]'' during the [[Death Seed]] outbreak of [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].
